title: Storytelling secret
description: 5 & 6 together are unreal if you want to become a better storyteller
transcript: Five habits to become disgustingly good at storytelling and here's how to use AI to do the heavy lifting. Number one, build a story bank. Create a folder on your computer called story bank. Anytime you screenshot a post, text, a quote, or idea that makes you feel something, throw it in there. Claude can read that folder, organize them by emotion, topic, and story type. So, instead of having 500 random screenshots, you can ask, "Give me five stories about failure." Number two, capture your life. Create a folder called life log. Drop in voice memos, photos, notes, and random observations throughout your day. Claude can connect those files together and serve as patterns you wouldn't notice yourself. A photo from a Tuesday pulls a voice memo from your Friday, might become the story you never realized you had. Number three is to study great stories. Create a reference folder. Whenever a video or post grabs your attention, save the transcript. Claude can break it down into the hook, setup, tension, payoff, pacing, and language. Now, you're not just consuming good storytelling, you have a library of structures you can study. Number four, practice every day. Open Claude and say, "Give me a random word and emotion." Give yourself 60 seconds to tell a story connecting the two. Then give Claude the transcript and have it tell you exactly where you lost attention and how to improve it. You're getting feedback every single time you practice. Five, build your story OS. Connect your story bank, life log, and references together in Claude. Now, instead of asking AI to write you stories, you can ask it, "Find a story from my life that proves this idea." Claude becomes the memory and retrieval layer behind your storytelling. So, if you want to start using AI to become a better storyteller, comment storyteller down below and I will send you my free setup guide.
